chk.text: The growth of Towashi consumed the edges of Jukai Forest and enclosed the grove of Boseiju, displacing the forest kami, whose rage led them to close Jukai Forest to everyone including the orochi.
Toshi and Kobo went into Jukai for field experience, but orochi overwhelmed Kobo with numbers and poison, and Choryu drowned him.
Toshi escaped, rescued Michiko from sacrifice, and met the Myojin of Night's Reach in a cave.
Elsewhere in the forest, the kumo attacked the monks' shrine, beginning the six-year Battle of Silk, while Dosan kept praying even as kami hatred slowly killed him.

sok.text: Michiko sent Toshi a kanji message that Eiganjo had fallen and the soratami were conquering in Takenuma and Jukai, and Toshi was briefly captured by orochi.
When Konda arrived, the Taken One summoned O-Kagachi, and Michiko freed the spirit within her, who was named Kyodai.
Michiko and Kyodai merged and defeated O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads, while Konda was turned to stone and shattered.

neo.text: Clear-cutting to build Towashi made Jukai Forest hostile to outsiders, as the kami it had driven out attacked the new buildings.
The emperor brokered an agreement halting Towashi's growth into the forest and forbidding the felling of Boseiju.
In the forest, Dosan taught the wanderer Azusa, and later Kaito met Tameshi, who became his mentor for nine years.
Years later, Nari confronted Kaito in the forest, and he fled with Eiko and Tameshi as the Order of Jukai clashed with the Reckoners.
